question: Can source-isolated weak-supervision evidence-scale fitting preserve useful visual rejection while preventing excessive rejection of real contacts?

reuse.visual_recipe: Unchanged ImageNet initialization, frozen stem/BN, trainable tail/head,16epochs,seed20261109,original event bags/backgrounds

nested_design.group_assignment: Within each outer train side only, sort9sources by decreasing candidate count then family name; greedily assign to smallest-candidate bin having fewer than3sources, ties by bin ID
nested_design.isolation: Each inner model trains6sources and predicts3 other outer-train sources; neither side contains outer-held source; every outer-train video predicted once for calibration
nested_design.initialization: Every inner model starts from original ImageNet, never the full9-source model
nested_design.application: Fit a scalar from pooled inner OOF training-side predictions, apply only to existing full9-source model predictions for the outer-held source
nested_design.remaining_limit: 6-source to9-source confidence-distribution transfer is not guaranteed; final outer source-held-out chain is the test

calibration.bound_reason: Fixed test of reducing excessive visual certainty; no amplification beyond the original visual model
calibration.objective: 0.5*mean(original event-bag latent target NLL plus competing-contact exclusion loss)+0.5*mean(all legal background NLL),using outer-training-side inner OOF only
calibration.ambiguous_event_frames: Original interval bags stay bags; do not label every member positive
calibration.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize_scalar(method=bounded,bounds=(0,1),xatol=1e-5,maxiter=100),compare its solution and both endpoints on the same training objective
calibration.interpretation: Weak-supervision evidence-scale adaptation, not proof of calibrated per-frame probabilities or a globally optimal scalar

integration.shortlist: Frozen original strict-boundary3757-candidate shortlist, always generated from unmodified CHANNEL heads
integration.scale_aware_primary: Take calibrated fixed-mean probabilities to power2/(1+a) then renormalize; when a=0 return original dense probabilities exactly, when a=1 retain original fusion arithmetic
integration.reason: Uniform visual evidence must not halve dense log-margin in later competition with the unchanged window branch
integration.other_chain_parts: Original candidate/time/XY, window, gap, table and80ms conflict remain fixed
integration.diagnostic_arm_selection: Do not retrospectively adopt a different diagnostic arm based on outer-held results

evaluation.control: Reproduce original CHANNEL and prior raw96-visual frame/PTS/XY exactly
evaluation.metrics: 121 strict/40ms temporal F1,source changes,recovered/lost events,class/dense-selection/union/gap/table stage changes
evaluation.continue: Primary genuinely improves complete-chain effect across sources and materially reduces previous true-contact rejection; returning to control or only fewer outputs is insufficient
evaluation.confirmation: If justified, freeze recipe, fit154 and require external130/public15 preset main metrics to improve with complete inference>=55FPS
evaluation.former33: Already training-in for main154, never an independent holdout now
evaluation.stop: No convincing net gain or source-general benefit; no follow-on temperature/weight/epoch sweep
